page_title: MNU 1-1 BUR | Manchester Utd v Burnley 27/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+7' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but the ball is blocked by one of his teammates.
90+5' Wilson Odobert (Burnley) zig-zags his way into the box and drills a low shot towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a superb stop.

90+3' Casemiro (Manchester United) leaps highest in the penalty area to get on the end of a cross from the free kick, and he produces a promising goal-bound header low towards the middle of the goal, but Arijanet Muric pulls off a comfortable save to deny him.
90+2' Erik ten Hag is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Scott McTominay suffers an injury and Mason Mount (Manchester United) comes on.
90+2' Maxime Esteve (Burnley) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Surely that's handball by one of the Burnley players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
90' Antony (Manchester United) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
87' 1 - 1 Goal! Zeki Amdouni (Burnley) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Andre Onana to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom right corner.
87' Zeki Amdouni (Burnley) is going to take the penalty!
87' It’s a PENALTY to Burnley after the VAR review!
85' There's a break in play and referee John Brooks must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Burnley using VAR. This could be interesting!
85' Johann Berg Gudmundsson (Burnley) receives a rebound and has a go from distance. His shot flies towards the goal, but is blocked at the last moment by a defender.
85' One of the Burnley players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
84' John Brooks couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Harry Maguire (Manchester United) and blew his whistle.
82' Johann Berg Gudmundsson (Burnley) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
81' Here is a change. Christian Eriksen is going off and Erik ten Hag gives the last tactical orders to Sofyan Amrabat (Manchester United).
79' 1 - 0 GOAL! Antony (Manchester United) gets to the ball on the edge of the box after a huge mistake by an opponent and slams it into the back of the net. He makes it 1:0.
77' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar.
72' We are about to witness a substitution. Johann Berg Gudmundsson (Burnley) is replacing Jacob Bruun Larsen.
69' The resulting corner from Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
69' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) decided to shoot after receiving a sweet pass. If it wasn't for Arijanet Muric's superb save the ball would have probably ended up in the top of the net.
69' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
69' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. Manchester Utd have been awarded a corner kick.
66' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
65' Erik ten Hag prepares a substitution. Rasmus Hojlund is replaced by Amad Diallo (Manchester United).
65' That will be all from Kobbie Mainoo who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Scott McTominay (Manchester United).
65' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Now Manchester Utd have a corner.
64' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
61' That's unlucky! Zeki Amdouni (Burnley) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
60' John Brooks shows a yellow card to Josh Cullen (Burnley) for his blatant foul.
59' Zeki Amdouni (Burnley) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort!
57' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Zeki Amdouni (Burnley) is coming onto the pitch as David Datro Fofana cannot continue after picking up an injury.
56' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

55' Aaron Wan-Bissaka (Manchester United) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Manchester Utd.
55' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) lacks options so goes solo. It's a fine run and good shot from inside the box, but it's a whisker past the right post.
51' Casemiro (Manchester United) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.

51' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Antony (Manchester United) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the middle of the goal, but Arijanet Muric pulls off an easy save.
51' A pass into the box finds Antony (Manchester United) unmarked. He carefully places a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Arijanet Muric denies him.
49' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) strikes the ball goalwards from a mid-range free kick, but his effort only goes towards the middle of the goal and presents no problem for the goalkeeper.
45+2' Casemiro (Manchester United) was too forceful with his tackle and John Brooks interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Burnley.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
44' Vitinho (Burnley) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
43' Antony (Manchester United) is booked after bringing down an opponent. John Brooks had an easy-decision to make.
42' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Wilson Odobert (Burnley) was quite harsh and John Brooks didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
41' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) drives into the box and hits a tremendous shot that, unluckily for him, flashes just wide of the left post.
41' A pass lands at the feet of Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
41' Dara O'Shea (Burnley) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left John Brooks no option but to blow his whistle.
39' Lyle Foster (Burnley) picks up a pass and unleashes a strong shot from inside the box directed towards the right post, but the goalkeeper is equal to it!
35' Burnley have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

35' Lyle Foster (Burnley) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the middle of the goal, but Andre Onana is prepared to thwart his effort. Burnley have been awarded a corner kick.
34' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
33' A clumsy foul by Aaron Wan-Bissaka (Manchester United) and John Brooks blows his whistle.
32' Great chance! Dara O'Shea (Burnley) picks up a rebound inside the box, cuts inside his marker but rifles his shot high over the bar.
31' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) takes the corner which is cleared.
31' Vitinho (Burnley) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The referee blows his whistle, Burnley are awarded a corner kick.
29' Lyle Foster (Burnley) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. His effort sails well wide of the right post.
27' Burnley failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

27' That was a nice football moment. Wilson Odobert (Burnley) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the roof of the net. Andre Onana guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save! The linesman makes the right call and Burnley will have a corner.
27' The corner kick from Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
26' Vitinho (Burnley) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out. The referee points to the corner flag and Burnley will take a corner.
22' Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
21' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
19' Post! Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) pounces on the rebound inside the penalty box and tries to prod home! He's unlucky as the ball only rattles the left post.
17' Dara O'Shea (Burnley) commits a rough challenge and John Brooks blows his whistle for a foul.
16' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
16' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked. The ball is out of play. Manchester Utd win a corner kick.
11' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Christian Eriksen (Manchester United), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the right post.

8' Antony (Manchester United) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the top left corner, but Arijanet Muric was alert and the score remains the same.
8' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
7' Casemiro (Manchester United) brings down the pass, looks up and shoots from distance, but it's straight at a defender who unwittingly blocks it. Good work from Manchester Utd as they win a corner.
5' Lorenz Assignon (Burnley) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee.
3' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) latches onto a brilliant cross and fires the ball towards goal, but his shot goes high over the crossbar.
2' John Brooks blows his whistle. Vitinho (Burnley) commits a foul after dangerous play.
1' David Datro Fofana (Burnley) picks up a pass and unleashes a low shot towards goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Andre Onana.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Burnley will have the kick-off.
John Brooks will supervise the game today.
